    Get variables (or measurement types)

    get_variable.Rd

    Get variables (or measurement types)

    get_variable(x, variable_table_name = "variable", ...)

    Arguments

    x

    database or dateset, e.g like db

    variable_table_name

    variable table name

    ...

    further arguments

    Examples

    
data(db)
variables <- get_variable(x=db)
#>        ID             name
#>     <int>           <char>
#>  1:     1             TEMP
#>  2:     2             DEWP
